title: 280. Unique Binary Search Trees II

examples.explanation: All five BST shapes over 1..3 are returned in BFS form.
A single node is the only tree.

hints: For each root value r in [start, end], combine every left tree from [start, r-1] with every right tree from [r+1, end].
The empty interval yields a single null option so leaf parents still form.
Serialize each finished TreeNode with BFS (null placeholders, trim trailing nulls) and compare sorted lists.
